queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Keywords as you would type them on foundit.in, e.g. python developer, data analyst, sales manager. Each query is searched in every location below. Leave empty to list all jobs in the locations.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Optional city or country filter, one per entry, e.g. Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Singapore or Remote. Leave empty to search everywhere (India, plus Gulf and Southeast Asia jobs Foundit lists).

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: date: most recently posted or refreshed jobs first (best for monitoring). relevance: Foundit's default ranking.

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs in total, across all searches. Each job is billed as one event.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Add the full job description (plain text) to each job. Every job always has a short descriptionSnippet.

onlyNew.title: Only new jobs (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only jobs not returned by an earlier run with the same queries and locations. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-job alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new jobs. State is kept in the key-value store "foundit-jobs-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy. Not needed normally: the Foundit API answers datacenter IPs directly. If set, the actor switches to a new IP whenever a request is blocked or rate-limited.
